decisions.reason: Having survived the first review year and being a flagship product tightly aligned with the firm's strategic aspiration toward efficient, intelligent lighting, this line is likely performing at or above aspiration and is therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

Its continued presence suggests results have not fallen clearly below aspiration in its specialist marine niche, but because it remains less central to the firm's LED-oriented direction, it is still more vulnerable than the flagship lines if management reallocates resources to stronger opportunities.
